data.desc: Amwell (NYSE: AMWL) helps health plans, healthcare organizations and government agencies deliver connected, technology-enabled care that improves clinical and financial outcomes. The Amwell Platform connects consumer experiences, clinician workflows and clinical programs from Amwell and its partners to simplify access, strengthen engagement, deliver care reliably and support effective care across the continuum. For two decades, Amwell has served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide, enabling care for millions. Recent recognition includes Frost & Sullivan's 2026 United States Technology Innovation Leadership Recognition for technology-enabled care platforms, inclusion in TIME's World's Top HealthTech Companies of 2026, and selection as a quarterfinalist in the 2026 Digital Health & AI Awards.
